value_models.description: Expected direct Dodgers regular-season bWAR within 10 seasons of signing: the 041 probability of positive Dodgers MLB value (the player's reference population) times the mean 10-season Dodgers bWAR of positive-labelled, training-eligible members of the same population. Supported only when the 041 target is supported AND at least min_conditional_n positive observations with a known value exist.
